effect: Converts a charge into a fundraising total, and a courtroom into a stage with better lighting.
tell: A legal defence fund launched before the arraignment, and merchandise with the case number printed on it.
expires: At the verdict, or at the next indictment - whichever the base finds more energising.

confused_with.tell: The martyrholic seeks the wound; the indictbump is what the wound pays. One is a temperament, the other a yield.

senses: A temporary condition in which being charged raises the bearer's standing with their own audience, because persecution is the strongest evidence of authenticity a movement can be handed.

It works because the charge is processed as proof of sincerity rather than proof of conduct. The base never has to believe the defendant is innocent; it only has to believe the prosecution is political, and any prosecution is political once you have said so first.
example: *"Four counts, and the **indictbump** cleared two million by Friday; the mugshot was on a coffee mug by Monday."*
